FULL TEXT:
Dr. S.S. BHATNAGAR UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGG.
& TECH., PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Advertisement for PROFESSOR OF PRACTICE (POP)/ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR OF
PRACTICE (ASSOCIATE POP)
Dr. S.S. Bhatnagar University Institute of Chemical Engineering and Technology, Panjab
University, Chandigarh, invites applications for Four (04) posts of Professor of
Practice(POPs)/Associate Professor of Practice (POPs). The aim is to get benefit of the expertise
of industry experts and using their experience to enrich students for a better understanding and
appreciation of the best practices as applied in real world problems. The applications are invited
in the areas of Chemical Engineering.
Expectation: Professor of Practice(POPs)/Associate Professor of Practice (POPs) will be
expected to teach in different programs as per the norms of the University; to take part in
academic activities and promoting industry-institute linkages and provide students with a better
understanding of the practical applications in a particular field.
Eligibility for Professor of Practice (POPs):
1. Ph.D. with relevant 10 year of experience in large conglomerate*
Or
2. Masters with relevant working experience of 15 years in large Conglomerate*
Or
3. B.Tech. with relevant working experience of Seventeen (17) year of experience in large
conglomerate*
Or
4. Ph.D./Masters/B.Tech. with minimum five (5) patents and 5 years of experience in the
start-up
Ph.D. is desirable for guiding researchers at Ph.D. level but not mandatory for teaching
Eligibility for Associate Professor of Practice (Associate POPs):
1. Ph.D. with relevant 5 year of experience in large conglomerate*
Or
2. Masters with relevant working experience of 10 years in large Conglomerate*
Or
3. B.Tech. with relevant working experience of Twelve (12) year of experience in large
conglomerate*
Or
4. Ph.D./Masters/B.Tech. with minimum five (5) patents and three (3) year of experience in
the start-up
Ph.D. is desirable for guiding researchers at Ph.D. level but not mandatory for teaching
Appointment Norms: The Professor of Practice(POPs)/Associate Professor of Practice (POPs) is
a contractual appointment. The engagement may be assessed after one year by the University. At
the end of the initial engagement or subsequent extension, the University will make an
assessment and take the decision about extension (one year at a time). The leave norms will be as
per University rules.
Honorarium:
 Professor of Practice (POPs) INR 60,000 per month
 Associate Professor of Practice (POPs) INR 50,000 per month.
Interested candidates may apply by sending their detailed resume along with a signed cover
letter (and all supporting documents) addressed to Chairperson, Dr. SSB UICET, Panjab
University to the e-mail id: drssbuicetpanjabuniversity@gmail.com
The last date for applying 15.07.2026.
Duties: The Professor of Practice(POPs)/Associate Professor of Practice (POPs) is expected to
perform a wide range of duties including:
1. Design, development and offering of new practice-oriented courses;
2. Advise students in their projects linking them with appropriate external stakeholders;
3. Encourage students in innovation and entrepreneurship projects and provide necessary
mentorship for their activities.
4. Engage in industry academia collaborations.
5. Professors of Practice are expected to guide Bachelor’s students in their project work and
start-ups.
6. Engage in centre building activities including creation of industry sponsored laboratories,
CSR projects.
7. Teaching/Practicals
General Conditions:
 The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts or not to fill the post
without assigning any reason.
** For the definition of large conglomerate, please see the website of AICTE at
https://www.aicte.gov.in/sites/default/files/approval/2025-26/APH%20Corrigendum-
Addendum.pdf
